name: Party_commonInstance
note: RPCommon::sInstance; Party_Common_create / Party_Common_destroy, called by every minigame

name: Party_leadCursorUseDebugTimer
note: RPLeadCursor::sUseDebugTimer; when set, Calculate forces both timers to Party_leadCursorDebugTimer

name: Party_screenFadeReloadColor
note: RPScreenFade::sReloadColor; when set, Calculate re-reads Party_screenFadeTargetColor

name: Party_titleBubbleInterval
note: RPTitleLyt bubble restart timer (5), Party_TitleLyt_calc / onButtonPress

name: Party_medalResultActorScale
note: per screen mode (RP 8043BBA8), RPMedalResult actor scale (+0x58) (16, 16)

name: Party_medalRecordOffsets
note: per screen mode, added to the record pane position (20, 110); Party_initStaticScreenOffsets

name: Party_dollScale
note: per screen mode, RPDoll actor scale (+0x58) (15.5, 16.5)

name: Party_dollLookDistance
note: passed with the pointer to RPDollBase::LookAt by Party_Doll_lookAtPointer (500)

name: Party_dollAngles
note: [screen mode][player] doll Y rotation in degrees, Party_Doll_calc (5, -5)

name: Party_dollOffsets1P
note: per screen mode, single-player doll screen offset ((0, -40), (0, -44)); Party_initStaticDollOffsets, Party_Doll_setScreenPos

name: Party_dollOffsets2P
note: [screen mode][player] two-player doll screen offsets ((25, -44), (-25, -44)), ((8, -44), (-8, -44)); Party_initStaticDollOffsets, Party_Doll_setScreenPos

name: Party_dollLookSpeed
note: 0.3142 (set by Party_initStaticDollOffsets); passed to RPDollBase::LookAt / LookAtTarget

name: Party_crowdBaseZ
note: RPCrowdMii Reset Z offset (-1500); its negation initialises Party_crowdLookDistance

name: Party_crowdEdgeX
note: screen-edge X (times the screen aspect) where crowd Miis start and leave (1500)

name: Party_crowdLookDistance
note: -Party_crowdBaseZ, set by Party_initStaticCrowdLookParams; passed to RPDollBase::LookAt

name: Party_medalThresholds
note: per game score thresholds for the medals, copied by Party_MedalResult_enterRecord

name: Party_selectGameNeighbors
note: neighbouring slot per direction (-1 none), Party_SelectGameLyt_getNeighborGame

name: Party_dollTableReactions
note: six 0x10-byte reaction entries (blend frames, animation ...), Party_Doll_enterTableReaction / calcTableReaction

name: Party_rankGetLytStateFuncs
note: enter/calc per state; copied by the RPRankGetLyt constructor

name: Party_vsWinnerStateFuncs
note: copied by the RPVsWinner constructor (inside dtk symbol 8031CB18)

name: Party_selectGameLytSlotStateFuncs
note: per game slot; inside dtk symbol 8031CEA0

name: Party_selectGameLytLockedStateFuncs
note: per locked icon; inside dtk symbol 8031CEA0

name: Party_crowdMiiStateFuncs
note: copied by the RPCrowdMii constructor (state 0 has none)

name: Party_titleLytStateFuncs
note: main machine, copied by the RPTitleLyt constructor
